verdict.rationale: AutoGen is a library installed locally via pip from its GitHub repo, and agents run in the user's own Python environment. AutoGen Studio documents exporting teams to Python code and running them in a Docker container, so the core product runs on user infrastructure. missing for 10: explicit open-source license statement, dedicated self-hosting/deployment documentation (e.g., hosting Studio or endpoints in production), independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
